name: 61115 · Machesney Pk, IL
findings: ZIP 61115 (Machesney Pk) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61115 (Machesney Pk) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
